prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input image: reference previous warm flat 2D forest game concept, edit target. Redesign the board with corrected wand placement and three truly different hat SHAPES, not palette swaps.
Camera invariant: exact 90-degree zenith overhead flat 2D, only hats and wands, no faces bodies or standing character, no isometric perspective or vertical sidewalls. All characters face screen UP. Every hat crown tip bends straight BACK toward screen DOWN along centerline, never to side. Important wand fix for ALL sprites: wand is a vertical straight stick pointing screen UP, but its axis is OFFSET RIGHT by about 60 percent of brim radius, as if held in right hand hidden beneath hat. Draw wand BEHIND hat: bottom 40 percent of shaft is OCCLUDED by brim, disappears beneath top-right quadrant, only upper shaft and crystal emerge past upper-right brim edge. It MUST NOT be attached to center buckle or crown, MUST NOT be diagonal, MUST NOT sit entirely separate with a gap. No visible hand necessary.
Layout landscape: left half spacious forest arena gameplay mockup using corrected hat 01, pale sage floor, dark moss surroundings, two round overhead enemy heads and small rune; almost no obstacles, tiny grass accents, trees outside arena. Right half THREE equally large top-down sprite design samples side by side or triangular layout, labels English "01 / PATCHED", "02 / SCALLOPED", "03 / WAYFARER". All THREE hats use the SAME coral cloth color #EF795E to make shape differences obvious. Neutral ochre/dark brown bands, brass hardware, dark pine outlines, light warm parchment board.
01 PATCHED: broad roughly circular uneven brim, medium length soft backward bent crown, small cloth patch same coral hue in darker tone, four short stitches, rectangular buckle.
02 SCALLOPED: unmistakable six-lobed rounded flower-shaped brim seen from above (not a circle), compact short backward bent crown, slim dark neutral cord band with small round brass clasp, NO patch. Distinct outer silhouette, only 6 large lobes not tiny frills.
03 WAYFARER: narrow rounded-diamond/octagonal brim in overhead PLAN VIEW, roughly equal horizontal and vertical extent not perspective ellipse, long slender backward bent tapered crown reaching near bottom brim edge, broad neutral dark band with two small brass studs, two simple seam strokes, NO patch or flower lobes. Distinct silhouette.
All cloth parts including patches and crown are tintable material in same base color, dark folds represented as relative darker base tone; no hat variant defined by fixed colored fabric decoration. Small footer says "SHAPE VARIANTS / ANY CLOTH COLOR". Under samples tiny three swatches coral / sage / blue with arrows to a single small hat silhouette, indicating recolor capability, not additional shape variants. The main three remain IDENTICAL coral hue.
Style warm calm storybook, simple flat shapes, clean chunky dark outlines, modest details readable at small game scale. No realistic textures, no gradients, no glow, no cast shadows, no volumetric render. Palette #182C28 #496B4A #B8C88D #E9DDBB #C58A45 #EF795E. Critical successful correction: wand parallel to UP direction, offset RIGHT, partially hidden UNDER hat, for every wizard. Preserve backward crown for all designs.
